units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 5:2:7">Y. Bets. V, 63ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="K00003"><he>כָּא</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Yoma 71b">Yoma 71ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>עמרא אִיפַּצּוּלֵי מִיפַּצְּלָא</he> wool (on the sheep) splits off (does not grow like stalks); <he>כיתנא נמי איפצולי מִפְּצִיל</he> but flax also splits!; v. <cite ref="K00651"><he>כִּיתַּן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Chullin 59b:5">Ḥull. 59ᵇ</cite> <he>היכא דמִיפַּצְּלָא לא דין וכ׳</he> when the horn is branched, there is no question (that the animal belongs to the beasts of chase, <cite ref="H00672"><he>חַיָּה</he></cite>).—
